notes: TITLE WITHHELD: the published title contains the swear word 'Bastards' ('Here Come The Bastards Redux').

Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING @#$% (8)': the Objective (posted 'SYCFA/Nobody Knows What's On The Back Of This'), Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (posted 'Death Star Dorking Bay'), Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and Secret Plans; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Section headers are not cards. Total 60 as published.
Posted 'Ability x3' is the Cloud City Effect Ability, Ability, Ability (one copy; the strategy calls it 'Abilityx3' and the 7-card Effects count needs one), not three copies.

Posted 'Asteroids' (a system under PLACES; strategy: 'get your asteroids out') dested the Dark Asteroid Field; 'Interceptor Laser cannon' x2 dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons (the TIE Interceptor weapon); 'Dreadnut' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Shield'/'Sword' The Emperor's Shield / The Emperor's Sword; 'Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; 'Suicide Vader (with his Saber)' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Hot Mara (aka Arica)' Arica.
Posted 'Come Here You Big @#$%' dested the Special Edition Effect Come Here You Big Coward; Secret Plans and Battle Order are the pre-Reflections III Effects.
UNKNOWN: 'Grabber' is shown as posted (Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant card, Aug 2001).
